Owned.setOwner: sets an address as potentialOwner, guarded by onlyOwner.
Owned.confirmOwnership: promotes potentialOwner to owner, guarded by onlyPotentialOwner.
StandardToken.transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to _to after balance checks.
StandardToken.transferFrom: moves tokens using an allowance from _from to _to.
StandardToken.balanceOf: returns balances[_owner].
StandardToken.approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
StandardToken.allowance: returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
SafeMath.mul: multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath.div: division with zero-divisor assertion.
SafeMath.sub: subtraction with underflow assertion.
SafeMath.add: addition with overflow assertion.
SafeMath.pow: exponentiation with assertion.
Token constructor: sets creationTime from now.
Token.transferERC20Token: owner-only withdrawal of an arbitrary ERC20 token via external calls.
Token.withDecimals: multiplies a number by 10^decimals using SafeMath.
PoetToken constructor: mints supply, splits foundation/ICO allocations and fills daysInMonth.
PoetToken.distribute: owner-only transfer of ICO tokens to an investor.
PoetToken.confirmOwnership: rewrites allowances before calling super.confirmOwnership.
PoetToken.allowance: returns availableReserve() when querying the foundation reserve for the owner.
PoetToken.availableReserve: time-based computation of withdrawable foundation tokens.
PoetToken.withdrawFromReserve: owner-only withdrawal from the foundation reserve.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balances and allowances.
Block timestamp (now) driving creationTime and reserve unlocking math.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter is only consumed by StandardToken.transfer and does not need an independent node.
The transferred value directly feeds the balance decrement arithmetic operation.
Source address parameter is an argument of transferFrom only.
Destination address parameter is an argument of transferFrom only.
The value parameter feeds the allowance decrement arithmetic operation.
Candidate owner parameter is only written by setOwner.
The unvalidated token address is the target of the unsafe external call.
Number parameter is only used inside withDecimals arithmetic.
Decimals parameter is only used inside withDecimals arithmetic.
Investor parameter is only forwarded to transferFrom by distribute.
Amount parameter is only forwarded to transferFrom by distribute.
Amount parameter is only forwarded to transferFrom by withdrawFromReserve.
First multiplicand is only consumed by the SafeMath multiplication.
Local product is only returned by SafeMath.mul.
Local balance is the amount drained by the external token transfer.
Elapsed-days local is only used for the reserve unlocking branches.
The percentage accumulator is the target of the loop increment operation.
Month index local only indexes daysInMonth inside availableReserve.
Day accumulator local only drives the reserve unlocking loop.
Unlocked token amount is the subtrahend of the locked-token arithmetic.
Locked token amount is produced by and consumed in the subtraction operation.
